selection.selection_input: validation only; completed before test prediction

analysis.evidence: Historical development only; two seeds, one warm-start epoch, three physical test positions.
analysis.limitation: Three physical test positions; two seeds conditional on the same B.2 initialization; one adaptation epoch; historical sessions unknown; no unbiased holdout claim.

plan.within_arm_selection: Minimum weighted validation loss over epochs zero and one; same initialization and fresh Adam per arm/seed. One-epoch bounded warm-start screen, not convergence.
plan.family_selection: Validation only. Both seeds must satisfy safety gates versus matched augmentation-off control AND B.2 anchor: empty false positives <= reference+1, missed occupied <= reference+1, overall correct >= reference-2, each black rook/king/queen correct >= reference-1, each orientation occupied correct >= reference-1, exact boards >= reference. Occupied accuracy must not regress in either seed versus matched control and its mean gain must be >=0.01. Rank eligible families by mean validation macro F1, then mean occupied accuracy. If none qualifies retain B.2. Representative seed fixed to 42; no best-seed or test selection.
plan.occlusion: Deferred: ground-square masks are not verified piece silhouettes; no current visibility reviews guarantee label-preserving partial erasure.
plan.combination: No combined augmentation arm in this bounded separate-family screen; do not combine without individual evidence and a further matched experiment.
plan.holdout: Existing historical prepared splits only, already inspected development evidence; final A.3 holdout unopened. Unknown historical session provenance remains a limitation.

leakage.checks: Position, source image, identical source bytes, identical placement, known sessions; derivatives inherit split.
leakage.limitation: Historical session IDs/timestamps are unavailable; independent-session or cross-position near-duplicate leakage cannot be certified. No new frames/splits are introduced.

cost.interleaved_scope: All 13 loaded models, identical 64 clean tensors in RAM, CPU4 batch16, two warmup boards/model, eight measured rounds with fixed randomized model order. No disk/transform/geometry timing. Initial raw per-model times are retained separately.

inference_preprocessing_plus_forward.scope: 64 loaded crop images: crop/detail transform, RGB/mask resize, normalization, tensor stacking and CPU forward. Excludes PNG loading, geometry and model load; not phone latency.

cost.scope: Training transform-only loaded 128 crop inputs, one warmup/three measured passes; no backprop. Inference uses identical B.2 tighter crop for every family, 64 loaded source crops, two warmups/four repeats, batch16 CPU4; excludes disk, geometry and phone.

recommendation: Retain the approved B.2 tighter-224 checkpoint without adding a new augmentation recipe.
